defects.defect: The plugin divides Uber's timestamp_ms by 1,000 before converting it, although its converter already normalizes milliseconds. Where the column holds Unix seconds, the time lands on 1970-01-20 to 1970-01-23.
defects.evidence: Reference backup (iPhone17,5, iOS 26.6.1; iLEAPP v2026.3.1, which reports itself as 2026.3.0): every timestamp_ms value in Uber's database.db tables hits and place has 10 digits, and the sibling artifacts Uber - Places and Uber - UR Message Locations date the same activity 2026-10-03. Code: scripts/artifacts/uberClient.py lines 410 and 447; scripts/ilapfuncs.py line 1456.
